servicesSub: Skilled, family, study, visitor and more. Call (03) 9863 6923.

services.title: Skilled & employer visas
services.long: Skilled visas and employer-nominated visas, including the New Zealand stream of the Skilled Independent visa (subclass 189).

services.title: Partner & family visas
services.short: Partner, child, parent and other family.
services.long: Family visas let eligible Australian citizens, permanent residents and eligible NZ citizens sponsor family: partner, prospective marriage (300), child, parent, carer and orphan relative (117).

services.title: Student & visitor visas
services.long: Student visas for full-time study at a recognised institution, visitor visas for holidays and family visits, and working holiday visas (417).

services.title: Business visas
services.long: Business visas for successful business people who want to settle in Australia and grow business activity here.

services.title: Protection & humanitarian
services.long: Protection visa (subclass 866), refugee and humanitarian visas and the Community Support Program (EOI).

services.title: Citizenship, NZ & reviews
services.long: Australian citizenship, New Zealand family visas (461) and PR, bridging visas, resident return visas and Administrative Review Tribunal reviews.
